unit: One world-conditioned admitted event -> CAN008 coupling -> typed owner effects -> memory/trace/access -> later admitted event response

inputs: feasible routes/opportunities, minority alternatives, typed unknowns
read-only owner state bindings CAN010/011, ADP015/016/017, CAN009 and prior response history
outputs: receipt with pre-state hashes and null status

inputs: eligible experienced generated facts or effect

candidates.label: NO_EXTRA_STATE_EVENT_RELATION_BASELINE
canonical_state: CAN010/011 only if earned by explicit accepted effects
candidates.cache_rule: Any derived motif/index is recomputable and invalidatable; not a new causal owner.
candidates.defining_risk: A history-derived predicate might be insufficient to represent a durable organization if the relevant learned update cannot be reconstructed.

candidates.label: RICH_CONATIVE_AND_PSYCHIC_MATRIX_COMPETITOR
additional_state: higher-order psychic motif distinct from relation history
obligations: exact state lifecycle and mutation authority
match same model and retrieval budget
candidates.defining_risk: Uncalibrated motives can duplicate existing state or become hidden narrative/identity shortcuts.

held_fixed: exact world snapshots and actual histories per intervention
same event feature inventory and n-ary source topology
same missingness and actor-safe claim ceiling
same prompts and identical retrieval budgets
same model ID, settings and token/call/latency ceilings when grants exist
same independent evaluator, held-out items and expected outcomes
fairness: B0 may query all lawful event/relation history; do not hobble it
B1 may not see evaluator-only inaccessible origin
additional rich compute must be counted, not declared free
no stylistic prose-only success; score typed owner-effect differences
equal_work.replay: Same exact inputs/rules and recorded RNG/model decisions imply same typed outputs; nonidentical stochastic runs do not count as identical-history replay.
equal_work.model_role: A future LLM may propose event interpretations, never admit occurrence, own memory or bypass target validation.

decision.integrity: Each required access/identity/owner/replay invariant strict; a single violation blocks positive admission
decision.baseline: Primary until held-out machine-level causal evidence of unique B1 incremental value
decision.rich: Retain only if independently reviewed held-out discriminant is passed by B1 and missed by B0 on matched admissible inputs, without null/access failures and within cap
decision.zero_difference: Remove extra primitive; may keep an invalidatable cache with no new semantic owner
decision.scientific_level: Bounded typed plumbing only; real-world psychological adequacy FU
decision.product_level: No PREV3/V3 operative wake or N12 from this lab design
